title: Fake Safety App
scenario: A link says your school now requires a safety app that tracks location all day.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Fake Safety App: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Location apps must be verified by school and parents.
